projectDescription: HelpAlive is an AI-powered user guidance platform that proactively detects when users are struggling inside your product and delivers contextual walkthroughs and support — before they ask for help.
keyFeatures: Crowd intelligence — learns successful navigation patterns from all users automatically
Proactive real-time intervention when users deviate from successful paths
Context-aware support chat that already knows where the user is and what went wrong
Interactive guided walkthroughs rendered inside the product
One-line JavaScript snippet install — no backend changes, no event tagging
Client-side PII scrubbing via Microsoft Presidio — zero sensitive data leaves the browser
Frequency controls to prevent guidance fatigue
Integrations with Intercom, Zendesk, Salesforce, HubSpot, Slack, and webhooks
publicApiSurface: identify(userId, traits) — identify the logged-in user
Webhook events for friction patterns and escalations
Guidance frequency and trigger configuration settings
